Garage login. Returns a JWT Bearer token — save this as {{garageToken}}.

Fetch the garage owner language preference for the language dropdown. Bind dropdown items from data.languageOptions and mark data.language/data.languageCode as selected. Dropdown options: [{ label: "English", value: "English", languageCode: "en" }, { label: "Hindi", value: "Hindi", languageCode: "hi" }].

Unified language-selection API. Use one endpoint for both English and Hindi by setting {{responseLanguage}} to English, Hindi, en, or hi. Missing or invalid language falls back safely to English/default behavior. Existing keywords language, preferredLanguage, and selectedLanguage are still supported; response keys and payload structure are unchanged.

Update the garage owner language preference from the dropdown. Accepts language, preferredLanguage, or selectedLanguage with values: English, Hindi, en, hi. If the user selects Hindi, future garage API responses are sent in Hindi. If the user selects English, future garage API responses are sent in English. Database stores English/Hindi; response also returns "languageOptions" for dropdown language selection.

Switch the garage owner language preference back to English from the dropdown. English is the safe default for missing or invalid language values. Future garage API responses are sent in English. Response also returns "languageOptions" for dropdown language selection.
Update garage location using GeoJSON coordinates.
